# Retained PerfectPower movement engine

These modules, their original tests, license, mathematical account and aggregate receipts were imported unchanged from the user-owned PerfectPower-Movement-Complete.zip release of October14,2026. The archive and source hashes are recorded in ../../receipts/canonical/donor_provenance.json. The Apache2.0 license is retained in LICENSE.

An isolated perfectpower import namespace stub was added. The core movement_language.py, movement_features.py and original transfer runner are byte-identical to the donor release. New canonical comparisons and their scouting-input restrictions live in the main NFL project, not in these retained originals. The donor archive remains available separately; unrelated PerfectPower application code is not copied into this NFL repository.

Exact integer populations/ranks, numerical inference under assumed weights and empirical football accuracy are different claims. Original donor source and result receipts are preserved for reproducibility and attribution.
